scope: Persistent launch-process preference and command-line overrides

contracts.behavior: Advanced contains Launching with a two-way bound separate-process checkbox; process reuse remains the factory default
Changing the checkbox persists in Xfconf, is readable from a separate process and survives reopening the dialog
A saved launch preference is applied before forwarding to an existing server; existing windows stay running
Explicit server flags override either saved value and the last supplied flag wins
Child arguments after execute or the option delimiter do not alter server mode; both server flags are accepted by the window parser
Independent terminal processes retain ListTerminals control services

environments.automated_gui: Private HOME/XDG, Xvfb and session bus; real GTK preference dialog and compiled terminal subprocesses
environments.native_wayland: The actual KDE preference dialog should be checked manually; Wayland rendering is not covered by the Xvfb checks
